annotation.notes: Contested: the court notes the Delhi HC (Mathur Polymers) allows consolidated notices and the Supreme Court dismissed the SLP in limine; Bombay follows its own Milroc / Rite Water line (paras 6-11). Schema gaps: TWO show cause notices from two different officers; the schema has one notice object (first one recorded, second in events). Outcome is 'partly allowed' with notices and order quashed and liberty to re-issue, not a remand. Odd fact not argued: the order (26/9/2025) came 8 days after the second notice (18/9/2025). Bombay numbers paragraphs '2]', first paragraph is just 'Heard.'
